config.name: apiKey
config.description: Generate at https://emblemvault.ai → Settings → Vault Access Key. tools/list works anonymously,

config.name: transactions
config.description: Set to "enabled" to expose state-changing tools. Omit for read-only.

tools.name: firecrawlExtract
tools.description: Investigate or Extract structured data from web pages or urls using Firecrawl

tools.name: websearch
tools.description: Search the web for current news, information, and announcements. Use this for real-time market insights and breaking news.Do NOT use it for real-time price data for prices and swaps, use quote tools instead.

tools.name: baseFindClankerTokens
tools.description: Find meme tokens on Base via Clanker (clanker.world). Returns tokens with price, market cap, 24h volume, and price changes. Use 'q' param to search by name/symbol. Sort by market-cap or created-at. To buy/sell Clanker tokens, use baseSwap — they are regular ERC20s on Base.

tools.name: baseGetBalances
tools.description: Get wallet balances on Base. CRITICAL: Use 'balance' for trades (exact units), NOT 'humanReadableBalance' (rounded for display).

tools.name: baseSwapQuote
tools.description: Get current USD price and swap quote for Base tokens. ALWAYS fetch fresh prices - crypto is volatile. Use 0xEeeeeEeeeEeEeeEeEeEeeEEEeeeeEeeeeeeeEEeE for native ETH.

tools.name: bscfindMemeCoinsViaFourMeme
tools.description: Find meme coins on BSC via FourMeme. Market cap is in BNB, price in USD.

tools.name: bscGetBalances
tools.description: Return the user's wallet holdings on BNB Smart Chain (chain ID 56): native BNB plus all detected BEP-20 token balances with contract address, symbol, decimals, and USD value where pricing is available.

tools.name: bscSwapQuote
tools.description: Get swap quote for BSC tokens. Uses Uniswap X or 0x. Use 0xEeeeeEeeeEeEeeEeEeEeeEEEeeeeEeeeeeeeEEeE for native BNB.

tools.name: isFourMemeToken
tools.description: Check whether a BSC token contract is registered on FourMeme and is still on the bonding curve (not yet listed / migrated off the curve). Returns the FourMeme token record if found.

params.name: tokenAddress
params.description: BSC token contract address to check against the FourMeme registry (0x-prefixed).

tools.name: getCoinglassBitcoinEtfList
tools.description: Provides a list of Bitcoin-based Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs)

tools.name: getCoinglassBitcoinETFNetAssetsHistory
tools.description: Historical net assets data for Bitcoin-based Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs)

tools.name: getCoinglassBitfinexMarginData
tools.description: Provides data on margin long and short positions from Bitfinex

params.name: symbol
params.description: The symbol of the cryptocurrency. example BTC

tools.name: getCoinglassBorrowInterestRate
tools.description: Provides daily borrowing interest rates for cryptocurrencies

params.name: symbol
params.description: The symbol of the cryptocurrency. example BTC

params.name: exchange
params.description: The exchange of the cryptocurrency. example binance

tools.name: getCoinglassCDRIIndex
tools.description: Provides historical CDRI (CoinGlass Derivatives Risk Index) data

tools.name: getCoinglassCGDIIndex
tools.description: Provides historical CGDI (CoinGlass Derivatives Index) data

tools.name: getCoinglassEthereumEtfList
tools.description: Get the list of Ethereum ETFs with pagination

tools.name: getCoinglassEthereumETFNetAssetsHistory
tools.description: Historical net assets data for Ethereum-based Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs)

tools.name: getCoinglassExchangeAssets
tools.description: Provides asset holdings data for exchange wallets, including address, balance, USD value, and price info

params.name: exchange
params.description: The exchange of the cryptocurrency. example binance

tools.name: getCoinglassExchangeBalanceList
tools.description: Provides a list of exchange balances for a given symbol

tools.name: getCoinglassFutureBasis
tools.description: Provides historical futures basis data, including open and close basis rates and annualized percentage changes

tools.name: getCoinglassFuturesWhaleIndex
tools.description: Provides a list of futures whale index data

tools.name: getCoinglassGrayscaleHoldings
tools.description: Provides a list of holdings managed by Grayscale Investments

tools.name: getCoinglassHyperliquidWhaleAlert
tools.description: Provides real-time whale alerts on Hyperliquid, highlighting positions with notional value over $1M

tools.name: getCoinglassHyperliquidWhalePosition
tools.description: Provides real-time whale position data on Hyperliquid

tools.name: getCoinglassOnChainTransfers
tools.description: Provides on-chain transfer records (ERC-20) for exchanges

tools.name: getCoinglassOpenInterestHistory
tools.description: Provides historical open interest data for options across different exchanges

params.name: symbol
params.description: The symbol of the cryptocurrency. example: BTC

tools.name: getCoinglassOptionsInfo
tools.description: Provides detailed information about open interest and trading volume for options across exchanges

params.name: symbol
params.description: The symbol of the cryptocurrency. example: BTC

tools.name: getCoinglassPremiumIndex
tools.description: Provides the Coinbase Bitcoin Premium Index, indicating price difference between Coinbase Pro and Binance

tools.name: emblemGetCollectionAssets
tools.description: Get all assets within a specific curated collection for vault creation

params.name: collectionName
params.description: Collection name (e.g., "Darkfarms", "SoG") - use emblem list collections first

tools.name: emblemGetDepositAddress
tools.description: Get the deposit address for a vault where you can send assets. Shows which coins are accepted.

params.name: tokenId
params.description: The vault token ID - get from emblem list my vaults

tools.name: emblemListCollections
tools.description: List all available curated collections for vault creation with asset details

params.name: showAll
params.description: Show all collections including hidden ones

tools.name: emblemListMyVaults
tools.description: List all vaults owned by the connected wallet (or a specified address), with optional filtering by status

params.name: status
params.description: Filter by vault status - empty to show all

params.name: address
params.description: EVM wallet address (0x...). Omit to use connected wallet.

tools.name: emblemResolveAsset
tools.description: Resolve an asset name to its curated collection. CRITICAL: Call this BEFORE emblemCreateVault when vaulting user assets to find the correct collection name.

params.name: assetName
params.description: The asset name from user wallet (e.g., "TESTNETPEPE", "PEPECASH", "FDCARD")

tools.name: ethGetBalances
tools.description: Get wallet balances on Ethereum. CRITICAL: Use 'balance' for trades (exact units), NOT 'humanReadableBalance' (rounded for display).

tools.name: ethSwapQuote
tools.description: Get current USD price and swap quote for Ethereum tokens. ALWAYS fetch fresh prices - crypto is volatile. Use 0xEeeeeEeeeEeEeeEeEeEeeEEEeeeeEeeeeeeeEEeE for native ETH.

tools.name: hederaAccountIdToEvmAddress
tools.description: Resolve a Hedera account ID in '0.0.x' realm-shard-num form to its 0x-prefixed EVM address by querying the Hedera mirror node (returns the account's alias or auto-generated EVM address).

tools.name: hederaContractIdToEvmAddress
tools.description: Convert a Hedera contract ID in '0.0.x' realm-shard-num form to its 0x-prefixed EVM address representation. Pure conversion — does not query the network.

tools.name: hederaFindMemeCoins
tools.description: Browse Hedera meme tokens listed on the MemeJob bonding-curve launchpad. Sort by market cap, creation time, last activity, or nearest-promoted; paginated for discovery feeds.

params.name: page
params.description: 0-indexed page number (defaults to 0 for first page).

params.name: orderDirection
params.description: Sort direction: 'desc' for largest/newest first, 'asc' for opposite.

tools.name: hederaFindTokens
tools.description: Search Hedera-listed tokens by name or symbol (substring, case-insensitive). Returns matching tokens with EVM address, name, symbol, and decimals. Omit the query to list all tokens.

params.name: query
params.description: Free-text query against token name and symbol (case-insensitive substring match). Omit to return the full SaucerSwap token list.

tools.name: hederaTokensSwapQuote
tools.description: Get current USD price and swap quote for Hedera tokens. ALWAYS fetch fresh - crypto prices change every second. Supports exact input (spend X) and exact output (receive Y) modes.

params.name: amount
params.description: Amount to swap (for exact input mode)

params.name: fromTokenId
params.description: Token to swap from (0.0.000000 for HBAR)

params.name: exactOutputAmount
params.description: Exact output amount (for exact output mode)

tools.name: nansen_defi_portfolio
tools.description: Get a wallet's DeFi portfolio: LP positions, lending, staking, farming across protocols.

tools.name: nansen_perp_positions
tools.description: Get current Hyperliquid perpetual positions held by smart money for a specific token.

tools.name: nansen_pnl_leaderboard
tools.description: Get Nansen PnL leaderboard for a SPECIFIC TOKEN CONTRACT (not a global wallet leaderboard). Requires a token contract address. Shows which wallets profited most from trading that specific token.

tools.name: nansen_smart_money_flows
tools.description: Get net token flows from smart money addresses. Shows accumulation/distribution by funds and whales.

tools.name: nansen_smart_money_holdings
tools.description: Get current token holdings aggregated across smart money wallets. Shows what funds and whales are holding.

tools.name: nansen_smart_money_trades
tools.description: Get recent DEX trades by smart money wallets. Spot what top traders are actively buying/selling.

tools.name: nansen_token_screener
tools.description: Screen tokens by volume, smart money activity, and chain. Find trending tokens that smart money is trading.

params.name: smart_money_only
params.description: Filter to show only smart money activity

tools.name: nansen_wallet_profiler
tools.description: Profile a specific wallet — trading activity, PnL, token trades over a date range.

tools.name: nansen_who_bought_sold
tools.description: See which smart money wallets bought or sold a specific token in a date range.

tools.name: openseaGetBestListings
tools.description: Get the cheapest (best) listings for an NFT collection. Use this for price discovery and finding deals.

tools.name: openseaGetCollectionActivity
tools.description: Monitor recent activity for an NFT collection: sales, transfers, mints, listings, and offers. Use this to track market activity and recent trades.

params.name: eventType
params.description: Filter by event type (omit for all events)

tools.name: openseaGetCollectionStats
tools.description: Get detailed stats for an NFT collection including floor price, volume, sales, owners, and market cap. Use collection slug (e.g., 'boredapeyachtclub'), not the collection name.

tools.name: openseaGetMyNFTs
tools.description: Get all NFTs owned by the user on OpenSea. ALWAYS use this tool first when user asks about their NFTs or NFT collection.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of NFTs to return

tools.name: openseaGetNFTListings
tools.description: Get active sell listings for an NFT on OpenSea

params.name: tokenId
params.description: The token ID of the NFT

tools.name: openseaGetNFTOffers
tools.description: Get buy offers for an NFT on OpenSea

params.name: tokenId
params.description: The token ID of the NFT

tools.name: openseaGetTrendingCollections
tools.description: Find trending NFT collections by volume, market cap, or price changes. Use this for market research and discovering popular collections.

tools.name: checkRuneUnlock
tools.description: Check when a specific rune name becomes available to etch.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the rune (spacers like • are automatically removed)

tools.name: getAlkaneAddressBalance
tools.description: Get the alkane balance for a Bitcoin address. This includes tokens, NFTs, contracts, and any other type of alkane.

tools.name: getAlkaneAddressUTXOs
tools.description: Get the UTXOs for a given Bitcoin address. This includes tokens, NFTs, contracts, and any other type of alkane.

tools.name: getAlkaneInfo
tools.description: Fetch metadata for a single Alkane by its protocol ID: name, symbol, supply, type, and contract details if applicable.

params.name: id
params.description: Alkane protocol ID in 'block:tx' format (e.g. '2:42'). Both components are required.

tools.name: getBitcoinCollections
tools.description: Browse all indexed Bitcoin Ordinals inscription collections (paginated). Returns each collection's slug, name, supply, and identifiers — useful for discovery before drilling into floor price or assets via getCollectionInfo / getCollectionMarketInfo.

params.name: page
params.description: 1-indexed page number for paginating the collections list. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: getBRC20Activity
tools.description: Return the BRC-20 token transfer history for a given Bitcoin address (deploys, mints, transfers, sends, receives) with timestamps and amounts. Paginated.

params.name: bitcoinAddress
params.description: Bitcoin address whose BRC-20 activity to retrieve.

tools.name: getBRC20TokenInfo
tools.description: Fetch protocol + market metadata for a single BRC-20 token by ticker: current USD price, total supply, max supply, mint progress, holder count, and market cap.

params.name: ticker
params.description: BRC-20 token ticker, typically 4 characters (e.g. 'ORDI', 'SATS'). Case-insensitive.

tools.name: getBTCBalances
tools.description: Return native BTC balances for the user's wallet, broken out by both the taproot (P2TR) and nested segwit (P2WPKH) addresses, in BTC and sats. Does NOT include runes, ordinals/inscriptions, or Counterparty assets — use the dedicated getRuneBalances / getInscriptionsByAddress / getXCPBalances tools for those.

tools.name: getCollectionInfo
tools.description: Fetch a Bitcoin Ordinals collection's metadata by its slug: name, description, supply, twitter, website, and image. Pair with getCollectionMarketInfo for floor/market data.

params.name: slug
params.description: Collection slug as indexed by Ordiscan (e.g. 'taproot-wizards', 'nodemonkes').

tools.name: getCollectionInscriptions
tools.description: List the inscriptions that belong to a given Bitcoin Ordinals collection (the collection's items). Returns inscription IDs and basic metadata.

params.name: slug
params.description: Collection slug as indexed by Ordiscan (e.g. 'taproot-wizards').

tools.name: getCollectionMarketInfo
tools.description: Get market info for a Bitcoin inscription collection: floor price in sats and USD, market cap in BTC and USD. Use this when user asks about collection prices, valuations, or floor prices.

tools.name: getCollectionVolume
tools.description: Get trading volume and market stats for a Bitcoin ordinal collection from Magic Eden. Returns total volume, floor price, supply, owners, and listings. Use this for questions about collection trading activity or volume.

tools.name: getCryptoPrice
tools.description: Get the current USD price of a major cryptocurrency. Use this when the user asks about the price, value, or worth of BTC, ETH, SOL, BNB, or HBAR. This is the PRIMARY tool for answering questions like 'What's Bitcoin worth?', 'ETH price', 'How much is SOL?', or 'Tell me about Bitcoin'.

tools.name: getInscriptionActivity
tools.description: Return the inscription transfer history for a given Bitcoin address (incoming and outgoing inscription movements with timestamps and counterparties), paginated.

params.name: bitcoinAddress
params.description: Bitcoin address whose inscription activity to retrieve.

tools.name: getInscriptionInfo
tools.description: Fetch metadata for a single Bitcoin Ordinals inscription: content type, content URL, current owner, satpoint, inscription number, genesis transaction, and timestamp.

tools.name: getInscriptionsByAddress
tools.description: Return paginated, fully-detailed Bitcoin Ordinals inscriptions held by a given Bitcoin address (number, content type, traits, satpoint). Use this to display a wallet's NFT-style holdings.

params.name: page
params.description: 1-indexed page number for paginating large inscription sets. Omit for the first page.

params.name: bitcoinAddress
params.description: Bitcoin address whose inscriptions to fetch.

tools.name: getInscriptionTraits
tools.description: Fetch the trait/attribute set for a single Bitcoin inscription (NFT-style traits used for collection rarity ranking). Returns an empty array when no traits are indexed.

tools.name: getLatestInscriptions
tools.description: Browse the most recently created Bitcoin Ordinals inscriptions network-wide (newest first by default). Use this to discover newly-minted inscriptions, NOT to look up inscriptions on a specific address.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order: 'inscription_number_desc' for newest first, 'inscription_number_asc' for oldest first.

params.name: after
params.description: Cursor: return inscriptions with inscription number greater than this value.

params.name: before
params.description: Cursor: return inscriptions with inscription number less than this value.

tools.name: getLatestRunes
tools.description: List the latest Rune tokens for market discovery and browsing. Use this when user wants to see new/trending Runes, NOT for checking their personal balance.

tools.name: getMagicEdenRunePrice
tools.description: Get rune market data from Magic Eden as an alternative data source. Use this if Ordiscan returns zero prices for a rune.

params.name: runeName
params.description: The rune name without bullet spacers (e.g., 'DOGGOTOTHEMOON')

tools.name: getOwnedInscriptionIds
tools.description: Return the list of Bitcoin Ordinals inscription IDs owned by a given Bitcoin address. Lightweight ID-only response — use getInscriptionsByAddress for full inscription metadata.

params.name: bitcoinAddress
params.description: Bitcoin address whose owned inscription IDs to fetch.

tools.name: getRareSats
tools.description: List rare sats (uncommon, rare, epic, legendary, or named single-satoshi units) controlled by a given Bitcoin address. Useful for collectors evaluating sat rarity holdings.

params.name: bitcoinAddress
params.description: Bitcoin address whose rare-sat inventory to look up.

tools.name: getRecentStamps
tools.description: Browse the most recently issued Bitcoin Stamps (newest first) for discovery. Returns asset name, image preview, creator, and timestamp. Use this for activity feeds and 'what's new' surfaces.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of recent stamps to return (1-100). Defaults to 10.

tools.name: getRuneBalances
tools.description: Get the user's Rune token balances.

params.name: bitcoinAddress
params.description: The Bitcoin taproot address to check rune balances for
